credit_line: Peter Rejcek / U.S. National Science Foundation (USAP Photo Library)
what_it_shows: The famous view: a vivid blood-red cascade pouring down the white Taylor Glacier face onto Lake Bonney ice, with a small dome tent bottom-left for scale. Taken 26 Nov 2006. 2968x1740. Do NOT reuse the USAP caption, which wrongly calls the red colour 'a form of reduced iron'; the red is oxidised iron.
best_segments: S1 hook (0-2.5s): slow push-in on the red cascade, 9:16 crop centred on x~60% of frame. Also works for the S4 callback ('isn't bleeding') as a pull-out.

license: Public domain: USAP Photo Library 'License Type: Public Domain' (Wayback 2025-07-16); Commons {{PD-USGov-NSF}} (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Blood_Falls_aerial_view_2013-12-21.jpg)
credit_line: Peter Rejcek / U.S. National Science Foundation (USAP Photo Library)
what_it_shows: Aerial of the glacier snout with a dark-red streak running down the ice like a wound, red stain along the moraine and turquoise meltwater moat. 21 Dec 2013. 4928x3264. The most 'bleeding' looking aerial.
best_segments: S1 hook alternative or S2 opener (2.5-4s): tilt down the red streak from ice to lake. 9:16 crop around x 55-75%.

license: Public domain: USAP Photo Library 'License Type: Public Domain' (Wayback 2025-07-16); Commons {{PD-USGov-NSF}}
credit_line: Peter Rejcek / U.S. National Science Foundation (USAP Photo Library)
what_it_shows: Oblique close aerial of the outflow: rusty-orange fan spreading over lake ice, deep red staining on the ice cliff and moraine, field camp tents on top of the glacier. 21 Nov 2014. 6000x4000, best close detail in the set.
best_segments: S2 'rusting as it hits air' (4-7s): slow zoom into the orange fan texture; 6000 px allows a 4x crop.

license: Public domain: USAP Photo Library 'License Type: Public Domain' (Wayback 2025-07-16); Commons {{PD-USGov-NSF}}
credit_line: Peter Rejcek / U.S. National Science Foundation (USAP Photo Library)
what_it_shows: Front-on aerial: red-orange stain pouring from a notch in the glacier face onto the moraine and pale orange fan on Lake Bonney; yellow tents on the shore give scale. 21 Nov 2014. 6000x4000.
best_segments: S2 (2.5-5s) or S4 pull-back. Centre crop on the notch (x~45%).

license: Public domain: USAP Photo Library 'License Type: Public Domain' (Wayback 2025-07-16); Commons {{PD-USGov-NSF}}
credit_line: Peter Rejcek / U.S. National Science Foundation (USAP Photo Library)
what_it_shows: Wide aerial: vast white glacier, small red outflow at the snout, frozen lake below, tiny tents and a red hut for scale. 21 Nov 2014. 6000x4000.
best_segments: S4 closer (12-15s): pull-out from the red spot to the whole glacier. Or establishing shot before S1.

license: Public domain: USAP Photo Library 'License Type: Public Domain' (Wayback 2025-07-16); Commons {{PD-USGov-NSF}}
credit_line: Peter Rejcek / U.S. National Science Foundation (USAP Photo Library)
what_it_shows: Side-on aerial along the glacier edge: red staining down the ice cliff, orange fan, brown Taylor Valley floor and another glacier beyond. 21 Nov 2014. 6000x4000.
best_segments: Spare B-roll; context of the dry valley (no snow, 'polar desert').

license: Public domain: USAP Photo Library 'License Type: Public Domain' (Wayback 2025-07-16); Commons {{PD-USGov-NSF}}
credit_line: Peter Rejcek / U.S. National Science Foundation (USAP Photo Library)
what_it_shows: Four researchers with a tripod stand on a bright orange-red crust in front of the stained glacier wall. 14 Dec 2010. 3008x2000. Same incorrect 'reduced iron' caption on the USAP page; do not reuse.
best_segments: S3 'microbes' (7.5-11s): scientists sampling = 'life in the brine' beat; crop to the people (x 60-80%).

license: Public domain: U.S. Department of State work, Commons tag {{PD-USGov-DOS}}
what_it_shows: Aerial taken 11 Nov 2016 during Secretary John Kerry's helicopter tour: crevassed glacier tongue with a brown-orange outflow fan below. 3292x2195. Less vivid red than the USAP shots.
best_segments: Spare aerial for S2/S4; no people identifiable.

license: Public domain: U.S. Embassy New Zealand Flickr, Public Domain Mark (FlickreviewR passed 2020-12-01), Commons tag {{PD-USGov-DOS}}
what_it_shows: Steep aerial: orange outflow fan between white glacier and turquoise lake ice, with tents on the glacier. 12 Nov 2014. 4608x3072. Strong colour contrast.
best_segments: S2 (4-7s): 'iron-rich water... rusting'; vertical crop works well because the subject is diagonal.

license: Public domain: NSF staff photo, NSF credit line 'Peter West / NSF' (NSF press release 16 Apr 2009, Wayback 2024-10-02); Commons tag {{NSF}} / PD-USGov-NSF
what_it_shows: Wide view across Lake Bonney to the Taylor Glacier snout under the Kukri Hills; faint orange stain on the ice face. 2100x1100. Low drama, good geography.
best_segments: Optional establishing shot; weak for the hook.

license: Public domain: NSF credit 'Peter West / NSF' (NSF press release 16 Apr 2009, Wayback); Commons {{PD-USGov-NSF}}
what_it_shows: Portrait 1396x2100: rock and ice above, with faint ochre brine run-off on the ice face at the lower left. Already vertical but the stain is pale.
best_segments: Low priority; usable as a vertical tilt-down plate.

license: Public domain: NSF credit 'Zina Deretsky / NSF' (NSF staff illustrator); Commons {{PD-USGov-NSF}}
what_it_shows: NSF 2009 cross-section 'Subglacial Microbial Communities in McMurdo Dry Valleys': Taylor Glacier over bedrock, subglacial brine pool, Blood Falls at the snout, Lake Bonney; text boxes say 'No light, No oxygen, High salinity... Rich in reduced iron (Fe2+)'; magnified bacteria (Thiomicrospira, Desulfocapsa). 1907x1200.
best_segments: Reference for our own mechanism diagram (S2/S3). Text is too small for 9:16; redraw rather than use as-is.

credit_line: Jill Mikucki / University of Tennessee Knoxville, via DLR (CC BY 2.0)
what_it_shows: Ground view from the lake ice: red stained moraine and ice face, with an NSF helicopter flying over mountains and dramatic clouds. 4 Dec 2014, IceMole campaign. 4160x2340.
best_segments: S3 (science expedition) or S4; on-screen or description credit required.

credit_line: Gero Francke / FH Aachen, via DLR (CC BY 2.0)
what_it_shows: Deep blue sky, long glacier wall, red outflow at the left, tiny helicopter and a person on the lake for scale. 21 Nov 2014. 4160x2340.
best_segments: Scale shot; crop the left third for 9:16.

credit_line: Gero Francke / FH Aachen, via DLR (CC BY 2.0)
what_it_shows: Red NSF helicopter parked on lake ice in front of the glacier; Blood Falls is only a small stain at the left. 17 Nov 2014.
Field camp tents in the foreground, with the glacier and an orange stain at the left. 23 Nov 2004. 1600x1200.
best_segments: AVOID: the ShareAlike term could attach to the edited reel, and the PD shots are better.

what_it_shows: Panel A: ground-level outflow fan in Nov 2018, with labels and green outlines drawn on. Panels B-F: sampling sites; panel E is an extreme close-up of red crust with a sample tube. 1072x1113, low resolution.
best_segments: Panel E crop could be a 0.5s texture insert for 'rusting'. Labels must stay or the crop must exclude them; a crop is an adaptation, so note 'cropped' in the credit.
